description: Six public papers represented by short hand-written English topic descriptions, not original abstracts. Queries and expected IDs were fixed before retrieval was run. This is a small diagnostic, not a personal-library benchmark.

documents.title: Attention Is All You Need
documents.description: The Transformer handles machine translation using attention instead of recurrent or convolutional layers. The encoder and decoder attend to relevant positions in a sequence. Its design permits parallel training and is evaluated on English to German and English to French translation.

documents.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
documents.description: BERT learns language representations from unlabeled text using context on both sides of a word. Pretraining includes predicting masked tokens. The resulting model is fine tuned for question answering and natural language inference with a small task specific output layer.

documents.title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
documents.description: A convolutional network learns to play Atari video games from raw screen pixels. Q learning estimates future rewards and guides action selection. The same learning approach is tested on seven games without changing the architecture for each game.

documents.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors
documents.description: Random dropout removes some feature detectors during each training example. This reduces overfitting in neural networks trained on small datasets. Neurons cannot rely on the presence of specific partners, which discourages fragile coadaptation and improves generalization.

documents.title: Effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of mindfulness-based cognitive therapy compared with maintenance antidepressant treatment in the prevention of depressive relapse or recurrence (PREVENT): a randomised controlled trial
documents.description: A randomized trial compares mindfulness based cognitive therapy with support to taper medication against maintenance antidepressant treatment. Adults with recurrent depression are followed for depressive relapse or recurrence. The study considers both clinical outcomes and cost effectiveness.

documents.title: Effect of exercise for depression: systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
documents.description: A systematic review and network meta analysis compares exercise interventions for people with depression. Randomized trials include walking or jogging, yoga, strength training and other physical activities. The analysis examines changes in depressive symptoms across exercise types and intensity.

queries.en: Which paper translates sentences without recurrent networks by attending to different positions?
queries.zh: 哪篇论文通过关注序列中的不同位置来翻译句子，而不使用循环网络？

queries.en: Find work on learning from left and right word context before adapting a model to question answering.
queries.zh: 寻找先从词语左右两侧上下文学习，再将模型用于问答的研究。

queries.en: Which study teaches a game playing agent to choose actions from screen images and future rewards?
queries.zh: 哪项研究让玩游戏的智能体根据屏幕图像和未来奖励来选择动作？

queries.en: How can randomly silencing neurons during training reduce memorization of a small dataset?
queries.zh: 训练时随机关闭神经元，怎样减少对小数据集的死记硬背？

queries.en: Find a randomized comparison of mindfulness therapy and continuing medication for preventing depression from returning.
queries.zh: 寻找正念治疗与继续服药在预防抑郁复发方面的随机比较研究。

queries.en: Find a synthesis of randomized trials comparing walking, yoga and resistance exercise for depressive symptoms.
queries.zh: 寻找综合随机试验的研究，比较步行、瑜伽和抗阻运动对抑郁症状的作用。
